1.t: Ṣãd. By the Quran, full of reminders

2.t: ˹This is the truth,˺ yet the disbelievers are ˹entrenched˺ in arrogance and opposition

3.t: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late to escape
3.tr: Kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin fanaadaw Wa-laata heena manaas

4.t: Now, the pagans are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a total liar
4.tr: Wa-'ajibooo an jaaa'a-hum munzirum minhum Wa-qaalal kaafiroona haazaa saahirun kazzaab

5.t: Has he reduced ˹all˺ the gods to One God? Indeed, this is something totally astonishing.”
5.tr: Aja'alal aalihata Ilaahanw Waahidan inna haazaa lashai'un 'ujaab

6.t: The chiefs among them went forth saying, “Carry on, and stand firm in devotion to your gods. Certainly this is just a scheme ˹for power˺
6.tr: Wantalaqal mala-u minhum anim shoo wasbiroo 'alaaa aalihatikum innna haazaa lashai-'uien yuraad

7.t: We have never heard of this in the previous faith. This is nothing but a fabrication
7.tr: Maa sami'naa bihaazaa fil millatil aakhirati in haazaaa illakh tilaaq

8.t: Has the Reminder been revealed ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us?” In fact, they are ˹only˺ in doubt of My ˹revealed˺ Reminder. In fact, ˹they do so because˺ they have not yet tasted My punishment
8.tr: A-unzila 'alaihiz zikru min baininaa; bal hum fee shakkin min Zikree bal lammaa yazooqoo 'azaab

9.t: Or ˹is it because˺ they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Almighty, the Giver ˹of all bounties˺

10.t: Or ˹is it because˺ the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between belongs to them? Let them then climb their way ˹to heaven, if their claim is true˺
10.tr: Am lahum mulkus samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-maa bainahumaa falyartaqoo fil asbaab

11.t: This is just another ˹enemy˺ force bound for defeat out there
11.tr: Jundum maa hunaalika mahzoomum minal Ahzaab

12.t: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺, as did ’Âd, Pharaoh of the mighty structures
12.tr: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohinw Wa-'Aadunw Wa-Fir'awnu zul awtaad

13.t: Thamûd, the people of Lot, and the residents of the Forest. These were ˹all˺ enemy forces
13.tr: Wa-Samoodu Wa-qawmu Lootinw Wa-As-haabul 'Aykah; ulaaa'ikal Ahzaab

14.t: Each rejected their messenger, so My punishment was justified
14.tr: In kullun illaa kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa 'iqaab

15.t: These ˹pagans˺ are awaiting nothing but a single Blast that cannot be stopped
15.tr: Wa-maa yanzuru haaa-ulaaa'i illaa saihatanw waahidatam maa lahaa min fawaaq

16.t: They say ˹mockingly˺, “Our Lord! Hasten for us our share ˹of the punishment˺ before the Day of Reckoning.”
16.tr: Wa-qaaloo Rabbanaa 'ajjil lanaa qittanaa qabla Yawmil Hisaab

17.t: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And remember Our servant, David, the man of strength. Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺
17.tr: Isbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wazkur 'abdanaa Daawooda zal aidi innahooo awwaab

18.t: We truly subjected the mountains to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with him in the evening and after sunrise
18.tr: Innaa sakhkharnal jibaala ma'ahoo yusabbihna bil'ashiyyi wal-ishraaq

19.t: And ˹We subjected˺ the birds, flocking together. All turned to him ˹echoing his hymns˺

20.t: We strengthened his kingship, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment
20.tr: Wa-shadadnaa mulkahoo Wa-aatainaahul Hikmata Wa-faslal khitaab

21.t: Has the story of the two plaintiffs, who scaled the ˹wall of David’s˺ sanctuary, reached you ˹O Prophet˺
21.tr: Wa-hal ataaka naba'ul khasm; iz tasawwarul mihraab

22.t: When they came into David’s presence, he was startled by them. They said, “Have no fear. ˹We are merely˺ two in a dispute: one of us has wronged the other. So judge between us with truth—do not go beyond ˹it˺—and guide us to the right way
22.tr: Iz dakhaloo 'alaa Daawooda fafazi'a minhum qaaloo laa takhaf khasmaani baghaa ba'dunaa 'alaa ba'din fahkum bainanaaa bilhaqqi Wa-laa tushtit wahdinaaa ilaa Sawaaa'is Siraat

23.t: This is my brother. He has ninety-nine sheep while I have ˹only˺ one. ˹Still˺ he asked me to give it up to him, overwhelming me with ˹his˺ argument.”
23.tr: Inna haazaaa akhee lahoo tis'unw Wa-tis'oona na'jatanw Wa-liya na'jatunw waahidah; faqaala akfilneeha Wa-'azzanee fil khitaab

24.t: David ˹eventually˺ ruled, “He has definitely wronged you in demanding ˹to add˺ your sheep to his. And certainly many partners wrong each other, except those who believe and do good—but how few are they!” Then David realized that We had tested him so he asked for his Lord’s forgiveness, fell down in prostration, and turned ˹to Him in repentance˺
24.tr: Qaala laqad zalamaka bisu-'aali na'jatika ilaa ni'aajih; Wa-inna kaseeran minal khulataaa'i la-yabghee ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din illal lazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati Wa-qaleelun maa hum; Wa-zanna Daawoodu annamaa fatannaahu fastaghfara Rabbahoo Wa-kharra raaki'anw Wa-anaab

25.t: So We forgave that for him. And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination
25.tr: Faghafarnaa lahoo zaalik; Wa-inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa Wa-husna ma-aab

26.t: ˹We instructed him:˺ “O David! We have surely made you an authority in the land, so judge between people with truth. And do not follow ˹your˺ desires or they will lead you astray from Allah’s Way. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s Way will suffer a severe punishment for neglecting the Day of Reckoning.”
26.tr: Yaa-Daawoodu innaa ja'alnaaka khaleefatan fil ardi fahkum bainan naasi bilhaqqi Wa-laa tattabi'il hawaa fayudillaka 'an sabeelil laah; innal lazeena yadilloona 'an sabeelil laah; lahum 'azaabun shadeedum bimaa nasoo Yawmal Hisaab

27.t: We have not created the heavens and earth and everything in between without purpose—as the disbelievers think. So woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire
27.tr: Wa-maa khalaqnas samaaa'a wal-arda Wa-maa bainahumaa baatilaa; zaalika zannul lazeena kafaroo; fa-waylul lil-lazeena kafaroo minan Naar

28.t: Or should We treat those who believe and do good like those who make mischief throughout the land? Or should We treat the righteous like the wicked
28.tr: Am naj'alul lazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati kalmufisdeena fil ardi am naj'alul muttaqeena kalfujjaar

29.t: ˹This is˺ a blessed Book which We have revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ so that they may contemplate its verses, and people of reason may be mindful
29.tr: Kitaabun anzalnaahu ilaika mubaarakul liyaddabbarooo Aayaatihee Wa-liyatazakkara ulul albaab

30.t: And We blessed David with Solomon—what an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺
30.tr: Wa-wahabnaa li-Daawooda Sulaimaan; ni'mal 'abd; innahoo awwaab

31.t: ˹Remember˺ when the well-trained, swift horses were paraded before him in the evening

32.t: He then proclaimed, “I am truly in love with ˹these˺ fine things out of remembrance for Allah,” until they went out of sight
32.tr: Faqaala inneee ahbabtu hubbal khairi 'an zikri Rabbee hattaa tawaarat bilhijaab

33.t: ˹He ordered,˺ “Bring them back to me!” Then he began to rub down their legs and necks

34.t: And indeed, We tested Solomon, placing a ˹deformed˺ body on his throne, then he turned ˹to Allah in repentance˺
34.tr: Wa-laqad fatannaa Sulaimaana Wa-alqainaa 'alaa kursiyyihee jasadan summa anaab

35.t: He prayed, “My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me an authority that will never be matched by anyone after me. You are indeed the Giver ˹of all bounties˺.”
35.tr: Qaala Rabbigh fir lee Wa-hab lee mulkal laa yambaghee li-ahadin min ba'dee innaka Antal Wahhaab

36.t: So We subjected to him the wind, blowing gently at his command to wherever he pleased
36.tr: Fa-sakharnaa lahur reeha tajree bi-amrihee rukhaaa'an haisu asaab

37.t: And ˹We subjected to him˺ every builder and diver of the jinn

38.t: and others bound together in chains

39.t: ˹Allah said,˺ “This is Our gift, so give or withhold ˹as you wish˺, never to be called to account.”
39.tr: Haazaa 'ataaa'unaa famnun aw amsik bighairi hisaab

40.t: And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination

41.t: And remember Our servant Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with distress and suffering.”
41.tr: Wazkur 'abdanaaa Ayyoob; iz naada Rabbahooo annee massaniyash Shaitaanu bi-nusbinw Wa-'azaab

42.t: ˹We responded,˺ “Stomp your foot: ˹now˺ here is a cool ˹and refreshing˺ spring for washing and drinking.”
42.tr: Urkud bi-rijlika haaza mughtasalun baaridunw Wa-sharaab

43.t: And We gave him back his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and a lesson for people of reason
43.tr: Wa-wahabnaa lahoo ahlahoo Wa-mislahum ma'ahum rahmatan minna Wa-zikraa li-ulil albaab

44.t: ˹And We said to him,˺ “Take in your hand a bundle of grass, and strike ˹your wife˺ with it, and do not break your oath.” We truly found him patient. What an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺
44.tr: Wa-khuz biyadika dighsan fadrib bihee Wa-laa tahnas, innaa wajadnaahu saabiraa; ni'mal 'abd; innahooo awwaab

45.t: And remember Our servants: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the men of strength and insight
45.tr: Wazkur 'ibaadanaaa Ibraaheema Wa-Is-haaqa Wa-Ya'qooba ulil aydee walabsaar

46.t: We truly chose them for the honour of proclaiming the Hereafter

47.t: And in Our sight they are truly among the chosen and the finest

48.t: Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Ⱬul-Kifl. All are among the best
48.tr: Wazkur Ismaa'eela wal Yasa'a Wa-Zal-Kifli Wa-kullun minal akhyaar

49.t: This is ˹all˺ a reminder. And the righteous will certainly have an honourable destination
49.tr: Haazaa zikrun Wa-inna lil-muttaqeena la-husna ma-aab

50.t: the Gardens of Eternity, whose gates will be open for them

51.t: There they will recline, calling for abundant fruit and drink
51.tr: Muttaki'eena feehaa yad'oona feehaa bifaakihatin kaseeratinw Wa-sharaab

52.t: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and equal age

53.t: This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning

54.t: This is indeed Our provision that will never end
54.tr: Inna haazaa larizqunaa maa lahoo min nafaad

55.t: That is that. And the transgressors will certainly have the worst destination

56.t: Hell, where they will burn. What an evil place to rest

57.t: Let them then taste this: boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus

58.t: and other torments of the same sort

59.t: ˹The misleaders will say to one another,˺ “Here is a crowd ˹of followers˺ being thrown in with us. They are not welcome, ˹for˺ they ˹too˺ will burn in the Fire.”
59.tr: Haazaa fawjun muqtahimun ma'akum laa marhaban bihim; innahum saalun Naar

60.t: The followers will respond, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this upon us. What an evil place for settlement!”
60.tr: Qaaloo bal antum laa marhaban bikum; antum qaddamtumoohu lanaa fabi'sal qaraar

61.t: Adding, “Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, double their punishment in the Fire.”
61.tr: Qaaloo Rabbanaa man qaddama lanaa haazaa fa-zidhu 'azaaban di'fan fin Naar

62.t: The tyrants will ask ˹one another˺, “But why do we not see those we considered to be lowly
62.tr: Wa-qaaloo maa lanaa laa naraa rijaalan kunnaa na'udduhum minal ashraar

63.t: Were we wrong in mocking them ˹in the world˺? Or do our eyes ˹just˺ fail to see them ˹in the Fire˺?”

64.t: This dispute between the residents of the Fire will certainly come to pass
64.tr: Inna zaalika lahaqqun takhaasumu Ahlin Naar

65.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a warner. And there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah—the One, the Supreme
65.tr: Qul innamaaa ana munzirunw Wa-maa min laahin illal laahul Waahidul Qahhaar

66.t: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between—the Almighty, Most Forgiving.”
66.tr: Rabbus samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-maa bainahumal 'Azeezul Ghaffaar

68.t: from which you ˹pagans˺ are turning away.”

69.t: ˹And say,˺ “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly ˹in heaven˺ when they differed ˹concerning Adam˺
69.tr: Maa kaana liya min 'ilmin bil-mala'il a'laaa iz yakhtasimoon

70.t: What is revealed to me is that I am only sent with a clear warning.”
70.tr: Ien-yoohaaa ilaiya illaaa anna maaa ana nazeerun mubeen

71.t: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay
71.tr: Iz qaala Rabbuka lilmalaaa'ikati innee khaaliqun basharan min teen

72.t: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”
72.tr: Fa-iza sawwaituhoo Wa-nafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen

73.t: So the angels prostrated all together—

74.t: but not Iblîs, who acted arrogantly, becoming unfaithful
74.tr: Illaaa Iblees; stakbara Wa-kaana minal kaafireen

75.t: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What prevented you from prostrating to what I created with My Own Hands? Did you ˹just˺ become proud? Or have you always been arrogant?”
75.tr: Qaala yaaa-Ibleesu maa mana'aka an tasjuda limaa khalaqtu bi-yadaiyya-'a stakbarta am kunta min al-'aaleen

76.t: He replied, “I am better than he is: You created me from fire and him from clay.”
76.tr: Qaala ana khairum minhu; khalaqtanee min naarinw Wa-khalaqtahoo min teen

77.t: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed

78.t: And surely upon you is My condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

79.t: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”
79.tr: Qaala Rabbi fa-anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

82.t: Satan said, “By Your Glory! I will certainly mislead them all

83.t: except Your chosen servants among them.”

84.t: Allah concluded, “The truth is—and I ˹only˺ say the truth—

85.t: I will surely fill up Hell with you and whoever follows you from among them, all together.”
85.tr: La-amla'anna Jahannama minka Wa-mimman tabi'aka minhum ajma'een

86.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹Quran˺, nor do I pretend to be someone I am not
86.tr: Qul maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrinw Wa-maaa ana minal mutakallifeen

87.t: It is only a reminder to the whole world

88.t: And you will certainly know its truth before long.”
